positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	C/C++ software design and implementation for proton accelerator delivery nozzle 
•	Create and maintain software design requirements, documentation and feature specifications
•	Subsystem interface design and implementation using TCP communications
•	Real-time embedded software analysis and design
•	Isolate system-level problems and perform root cause analysis
•	Created software for sharing high-speed power supplies between multiple scanning magnets
•	Integration of hardware and software components to control Magnet Power Supplies
•	Implemented UDP multicast data stream network under tight schedule constraints
•	Collaborate with hardware engineers to develop software solutions to hardware problems
•	VxWorks Board Support Package customization and development
•	Customer feedback triage and resolution

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Control applications for embedded network appliances, Java
•	Successfully shipped RF Analysis software, ported from Linux to QNX
•	Performed security analysis and hardening of Linux systems
•	Provided engineering support at customer sites
•	Active TS/SCI

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed embedded Linux software to control wide-band data systems
•	Developed and integrated network control software with custom FPGAs
•	Customized and built Linux kernels and drivers for embedded Intel platforms 
•	Analyzed requirements and created firmware design documentation
•	Created firmware upgrade capabilities and remote logging software
•	Worked closely with FPGA/Hardware to isolate and fix hardware problems
•	Developed and maintained multiple legacy subsystems

positions.title: Unix Admin Intern
positions.description:
•	Administration of Linux, Unix, and Windows servers to support engineering
•	Managed network services. NIS, DNS, NFS, etc.
•	Wrote scripts to automate administrative processes
